name: Dragon's Dogma
description: Ethan sets out to vanquish the Dragon that took his heart, but with every demon he battles, the more he loses his humanity.

episodes.name: Wrath
episodes.description: Father-to-be Ethan leaves his wife behind and takes orphan Louis to hunt for food in the mountains, where a pack of ferocious wolves set upon them.

episodes.name: Gluttony
episodes.description: Cassardis lies in ruins. When a magical Pawn revives Ethan, he vows revenge, embarking on a quest to slay the dragon that destroyed his world.

episodes.name: İmrenmek
episodes.description: Ethan ve Hannah, goblinler tarafından pusuya düşürülen gezici bir gruba yardım eder. Gruplar birlikte kamp kurar, ancak yırtıcı bir griffin yukarıdan saldırır.

episodes.name: Sloth
episodes.description: The pair make their way through a cavern that once housed a bustling narcotics operation. Deeper inside, a towering hydra stalks the depths.

episodes.name: Greed
episodes.description: Ethan and Hannah reunite with royal guards Simon and Balthazar, agreeing to help them destroy a greedy lich who commands an army of undead.

episodes.name: Şehvet
episodes.description: Hannah, ejderhanın inine gitmeden önce Ethan'ı bir handa dinlenmeye ikna eder. Odasında karısının bir görüntüsü, Ethan'ın geçmişini geri getirir.

episodes.name: Pride
episodes.description: Ethan makes his way to the Tainted Mountain to face the dragon and reclaim his stolen heart, or die trying.
